# Example Lint Helper: analysis

## What it does
Runs a fixed set of lint checks on a project and explains each finding in plain words.

## Reviews and score
- 120 stars, 8 forks, 3 open issues, last commit two weeks ago (GitHub API).
- No outside reviews found: none are listed on the usual sites.

Our score: **7/10**, because the checks are solid but the auto-fix script is risky.

## Security
skillcheck: needs review. The one "REVIEW BY HAND" finding (`fs.writeFileSync` in `fix.js`) is real: the script rewrites files without asking.

## Activation: automatic or manual
omp loads it by itself when you ask to "lint this project" or "check code quality". You can also call it with `/skill:lint-helper`.

## Overlaps with your skills
Overlaps in part with a general code-quality skill; nothing else.

## Honest recommendation
**Install with changes.** Keep the lint rules, remove `fix.js`. Cost: about 900 tokens of description per session.
